item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Patches `dspy.settings` with `send_stream` set, `caller_predict = None`, and calls `_get_stream_completion_fn(request, {}, sync=False, headers=custom_headers)`."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Mocks `litellm.acompletion` with an async generator, awaits `stream_fn()`, and inspects `acompletion_mock.call_args.kwargs`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Sets `track_usage = True` and asserts `call['stream_options'] == {'include_usage': True}`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts `call['headers']['Authorization']` matches the supplied bearer token."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Mocks `litellm.stream_chunk_builder` to return `{'built': True}` and asserts the awaited result equals that object."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
